chk_conclusion.label: accurate
chk_conclusion.poster_evidence: Routine biomarker trajectories can function as a passive, zero-burden digital biomarker for early functional decline, enabling preventive intervention before falls or observable mobility impairment occur.
chk_conclusion.reason: The poster's conclusion matches the reference, highlighting the utility of routine biomarker trajectories as a passive, zero-burden digital biomarker.

chk_limitation.label: accurate
chk_limitation.poster_evidence: ICD-10-coded outcomes represent documented clinical recognition rather than objective functional performance and may introduce detection bias. C-reactive protein and vitamin D were selectively ordered and highly sparse. Median imputation may not represent the clinical context of missing values. Evaluations used random cross-sectional splits rather than calendar-time validation, and comorbidity adjustment was not performed.
chk_limitation.reason: The poster lists the specific limitations of the study, including ICD-10 outcome coding, missingness/sparsity of certain biomarkers, median imputation, cross-sectional splits, and lack of comorbidity adjustment.
